in_sanskrit.name: शरिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings wealth and prosperity. Derived from the Sanskrit word शरीर (śarīr) meaning 'body' or 'form'. Goddess Sharika is often depicted as a beautiful woman holding a lotus flower or sitting on a lotus.

in_hindi.long_meaning: She who brings support, strength, and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: சரிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds the wealth in her hand firmly. Derived from the Tamil word சறிகம் (caṟikam) meaning 'wealth' or 'prosperity'.

in_telugu.name: శరిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who bestows wealth and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Sharika
